recommendations.title: Establish a board-level risk committee
recommendations.body: Establish a board-level risk committee to meet quarterly. The committee should report to the trustees and own the organisational risk register.

recommendations.title: Publish an annual safeguarding report
recommendations.body: Publish an annual safeguarding report within three months of year-end. The report should cover incidents, training completion rates, and remedial actions.

recommendations.title: Rotate external auditors regularly
recommendations.body: Rotate external auditors at least every seven financial years. Document the rotation policy in the audit-committee terms of reference.
